notes.title: Update 1.01 Patch notes - December 22 2017
notes.content:
Thanks everyone for playing Dragon of Legends and submitting your feedback so far. We have already started taking action on some things brought up by the community, and today's update addresses some of those issues.

[list]
[*] Dialogue with Angar changed to explain Expertise and their respective hotkeys.
[*] Hotkey information now appears in Expertise skill descriptions, and in tooltips.
[*] Changed skill descriptions to provide more information about attacks.
[*] Fixed a bug where changing weapons changed your class and reset skills to 0.
[*] Added two new background music tracks.
[*] New music added to various Norstead Interior structures. 
[/list]

notes.title: Dragon of Legends is now LIVE on Early Access!
notes.content: That's right! Dragon of Legends is now available for purchase on Steam Early Access. There's a 15% discount on the game until December 22nd, so now is the ideal time to hop into the game and try it out for yourself!
